caption: The drawing depicts the head of a bird-like creature, oriented in profile facing to the right. The head has a large, prominent curved beak that is light brown with subtle shading. The upper half of the head is dominated by textured, feather-like patterns rendered in muted greenish-gray tones, giving a scaly or wrinkled appearance. There is a single, large, round eye set within heavy, sculpted brows that also exhibit pronounced folds and texture. The overall color palette is primarily earthy, including greens, grays, browns, and beige. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements, centering all attention on the bird head. There are no visible markings, text, or accompanying artifacts in the image.
title: Eagle's Head
